Andy Burnham takes office as UK prime minister
DOJ activates dormant Alien Terrorist Removal Court
AI trade selloff spreads to Asia as Moonshot Kimi K3 crashes chip stocks
AliExpress fined €550M by EU over illegal and counterfeit products

research.note: Google News RSS wrapper URLs failed to resolve to their target outlets via curl or WebFetch; substituted with same outlets' direct URLs where available (BBC, CBS, NBC, Fox, CNBC, PBS, The Verge, The Hill, Al Jazeera, RealClearPolitics), plus one Reuters-wire republication (The Star, Malaysia) and two European wires (RTE, Euronews) for the AliExpress dossier where all body-fetchable RSS entries were GN-wrapped.

errors.detail: NPR Top/Business/Tech/World returned HTTP 403 (blocked by egress); PBS NewsHour returned HTTP 202 on first attempt and recovered on retry.

Google News wrapper URLs for Reuters, AP News, Axios, Guardian bodies did not resolve to their target outlets in this environment; direct outlet URLs used where possible, and a Reuters-wire syndication (thestar.com.my) plus RTE and Euronews were used to complete the AliExpress dossier so it met the two-body-source minimum.
The Hill returned HTTP 403 on direct-URL body fetches; those sources were dropped and slot 1 relied on CNBC, BBC (2), and Fox News.
